title: S'mores in a Cup
description: S'mores made with graham cracker crumbs and butter as the base and layered with chocolate and marshmallows are baked in muffin tins for an indoor version.
ingredients: 2 (14.4 ounce) packages graham crackers (such as Honey Maid®), crushed
6 (1.5 ounce) bars milk chocolate candy bar (such as Hershey's®), broken into squares

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line 42 miniature muffin tins with paper liners.
Mix graham cracker crumbs with butter in a bowl until evenly combined. Spoon graham cracker mixture into the prepared muffin cups, pressing into the bottom and up the sides to create a crust.
Place 1 chocolate square onto each crust and top each with 3 miniature marshmallows.
Bake in the preheated oven until marshmallows are puffy and chocolate is melted, about 6 minutes.
